title: Surgical traffic-shift operator for VPC runtime upgrades
creator: Lena Rodriguez
description: Build an automated "surgical traffic-shift" operator and supporting Terraform hooks for Private (VPC) data-plane/runtime upgrades that achieve effective zero-customer-downtime and deterministic rollback. The operator will perform fine-grained per-tenant traffic rebalancing, connection draining, KV cache priming probes, and progressive kernel warmup while integrating with our observability signals (latency/error SLOs, priming coverage). Acceptance criteria: (1) full upgrade of a 50-tenant staging cluster with <1% request error delta and 95th-percentile tail latency change <10ms; (2) automated rollback trigger and safe-state reached within 3 minutes for simulated priming regressions; (3) Terraform upgrade windows and operator hooks documented and runnable by infra engineers.
implementation_notes: Design: operator runs as a control-plane agent in the customer's VPC private control plane. Steps: 1) perform static compatibility checks (model binary + runtime kernel matrix) using preflight IaC hook; 2) create ephemeral target set with new runtime images; 3) begin micro-shifts: move 0.5% of weighted traffic per tenant per step; 4) run KV-prefix priming agent against new nodes using sampled session traces; 5) monitor priming coverage and tail latency; 6) if health signals are green for two consecutive windows, increase shift; 7) if thresholds breach, immediately cut traffic and initiate rollback using cached previous images and rehydrate KV cache.
progress_updates: 2026-02-19 - Lena Rodriguez: Kickoff meeting with Infra, Runtime, and DX teams. Agreed operator will expose a gRPC control API for shift commands and a terraform null_resource hook for preflight checks.
2026-02-25 - Samir Gupta: Prototype micro-shift controller implemented. Uses sticky session-aware hashing to avoid head-of-line cache thrashing. Initial tests on single-tenant cluster successful.
2026-03-02 - Priya Menon (SRE): Added KV-priming probe that replays sampled request prefixes; observed 60% priming coverage in first pass. We need to improve warmup for long-context tenants.

2026-03-06 - Security Review (Claire Zhao): Requested that the operator's credentials are scoped via short-lived tokens and that Terraform module supports KMS-Key rotation. Marked security_review_required.

2026-03-09 - Samir Gupta: Integrated rollback circuit-breaker hooking into alerting: if tenant error rate increases >2x baseline or tail latency increases >20ms for 2 consecutive 30s windows, operator will cut traffic for that tenant and mark for rollback.

2026-03-11 - Engineering review: Raised a trade-off: increasing shift step size reduces total upgrade time but spikes priming misses for large tenants; we set default step to 0.5% and expose override via terraform var 'surgical_shift_step_pct'.

2026-03-13 - QA: End-to-end test with 50 synthetic tenants in staging shows successful upgrade completion in 52 minutes with rollback simulation passing (cutover back to previous images and KV cache rehydrate took 140s). Documenting edge cases for long-running streams.
